def equation(x: np.ndarray, v: np.ndarray, params: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator

    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized

    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    k               = params[0]                    # Acceleration constant
    b               = params[1]                    # Damping coefficient
    c               = params[2]                    # Nonlinearity constant (if provided, otherwise set to 5)
    kb               = params[3]                    # Spring Constant if present otherwise set to 5∗c
    cn               = params[4]                   # Nonlinearity exponent; if not provided, set to a default for simplicity (e.g., 1)
    dn               = params[5]                   # Nonlinearity power; if not provided, set to a logical one (e.g., 3)
    m                = params[6]                  # Mass (m)
    Fwig            = params[7]                   # External driving force coefficient
    g                = params[8]                   # Gravity term coefficient
    w                = params[9]                   # Frequency term coefficient
    
    # Limiting parameters to physical bounds
    if c > 5:
        c = 5
    if Fwig > 10:
        Fwig = 10
    if cn > 3:
        cn = 3
    if dn > 3:
        dn = 3
